title: Cajun songs and the rival New Orleans bands, each with a weak spot
summary: Asked about Cajun songs, Charles instead ranks the New Orleans bands (Crescent, Eagle, Robichaux, Piron, Maple Leaf) and says Maple Leaf had no weak spot.
